newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel eyes growth in multi-media sales.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel eyes growth in multi-media sales.

text.p: Alcatel Alsthom hopes to generate around half of its turnover from multi-media services by the year 2002, its chairman said on Tuesday.

"It is likely that multi-media will account for already a quarter of Alcatel turnover by the year 2000 and a few years later possibly half," Serge Tchuruk told Reuters following a group's presentation on multi-media services.
He later specified this would take place by 2002.
Multi-media services now account for 10-15 percent of the Alcatel's annual sales of 162 billion francs.

Asked if Alcatel, which already makes telecoms equipment, planned to become a telecoms operator, he said: "No way. Everyone has its own patch of expertise. I supply systems and equipment and I let operators operate," he said
